name: io.github.dqj1998/japan-company-info-mcp-bridge
description: Offline MCP for verified Japanese corporate data: EDINET XBRL financials, NTA IDs, gBizINFO.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.coverage: 192 blue-chip listed companies (free); full 3,193+ dataset via one-time purchase at mcporb.store

tools.name: edinet_financials_usgaap
tools.summary: EDINET XBRL financials (P/L, balance sheet, cash flow, executive comp) mapped across J-GAAP / US-GAAP / IFRS.

tools.name: japan_corporate_registry
tools.summary: NTA 13-digit corporate number, registered address, legal status, and gBizINFO certifications/subsidies.

tools.name: japan_shareholders
tools.summary: Major shareholders and ownership structure from the 大株主 section of 有価証券報告書.

tools.name: japan_industry_benchmarks
tools.summary: Sector benchmarks (operating/ordinary margin, equity ratio, ROE) from 財務省 法人企業統計調査 via e-Stat.

tools.name: japan_company_search
tools.summary: Keyword / fuzzy / semantic company discovery by name, securities code, or corporate number.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.summary: Raw knowledge-base search (bm25 / trigram / vector / hybrid) — fallback for open-ended questions.
